description: Layer 4: SEO/GEO/AEO Pipeline Integration + Public Endpoints. Implement the SEO pipeline status, bulk generation, coverage stats, FAQ JSON-LD generation, public content endpoints (published-topics, faq-jsonld), entity health refresh, and deep scan history. Add a public content router for non-admin endpoints.
steps: Step 1: Update admin_seo.py - replace placeholder implementations with real ones. Implement: GET /seo/pipeline-status (query chapters grouped by subject, show generated/published/draft counts), POST /seo/bulk-generate (accept list of topic IDs, generate all SEO page types for each), GET /seo/coverage (published vs draft counts per subject), POST /seo/entity/refresh (re-probe entity SEO health - check indexing status via stored data), GET /seo/deep-scan-history (return history of sitemap scans from a scans collection or embedded field).

Step 2: Add to admin_content.py: POST /content/chapters/{id}/faq-jsonld - Generate FAQ JSON-LD entries from chapter topics (question=title, answer=definition). Store faq_jsonld field on chapter document.

Step 3: Create apps/backend/app/api/v1/public_content.py - new router for public (non-admin) endpoints: GET /content/chapters/{id}/faq-jsonld (returns stored FAQ JSON-LD for schema markup), GET /content/chapters/{id}/published-topics (returns published_topics array for TopicAnswerCard rendering). These endpoints do NOT require admin auth - they are public-facing.
Step 4: Register the public_content router in main.py with prefix '/api/v1' and tags=['Public Content'].
Step 5: Update the Chapter model in models/content.py to add faq_jsonld field (Optional[list[dict]] = None) if not already present.
acceptance_criteria: admin_seo.py has pipeline-status, bulk-generate, coverage, entity/refresh, deep-scan-history endpoints with real implementations
public_content.py exists with 2 public endpoints (faq-jsonld GET, published-topics GET)
public_content router is registered in main.py
Pipeline-status endpoint queries chapters grouped by subject and returns meaningful status data
